vars.name: ai.addignoreplayer
vars.help: Add a player (or command user if no player is specified) to the AIs ignore list.

vars.name: ai.animal_ignore_food
vars.help: If animal_ignore_food is true, animals will not sense food sources or interact with them (server optimization). (default: true)

vars.name: ai.clearignoredplayers
vars.help: Remove all players from the AIs ignore list.

vars.name: ai.nav_carve_height
vars.help: The height of the carve volume. (default: 2)

vars.name: ai.nav_carve_min_base_size
vars.help: The minimum size we allow a carving volume to be. (default: 2)

vars.name: ai.nav_carve_min_building_blocks_to_apply_optimization
vars.help: The minimum number of building blocks a building needs to consist of for this optimization to be applied. (default: 25)

vars.name: ai.nav_carve_size_multiplier
vars.help: The size multiplier applied to the size of the carve volume. The smaller the value, the tighter the skirt around foundation edges, but too small and animals can attack through walls. (default: 4)

vars.name: ai.nav_carve_use_building_optimization
vars.help: If nav_carve_use_building_optimization is true, we attempt to reduce the amount of navmesh carves for a building. (default: false)

vars.name: ai.npc_alertness_drain_rate
vars.help: npc_alertness_drain_rate define the rate at which we drain the alertness level of an NPC when there are no enemies in sight. (Default: 0.01)

vars.name: ai.npc_alertness_to_aim_modifier
vars.help: This is multiplied with the current alertness (0-10) to decide how long it will take for the NPC to deliberately miss again. (default: 0.33)

vars.name: ai.npc_alertness_zero_detection_mod
vars.help: npc_alertness_zero_detection_mod define the threshold of visibility required to detect an enemy when alertness is zero. (Default: 0.5)

vars.name: ai.npc_cover_compromised_cooldown
vars.help: npc_cover_compromised_cooldown defines how long a cover point is marked as compromised before it's cleared again for selection. (default: 10)

vars.name: ai.npc_cover_info_tick_rate_multiplier
vars.help: The rate at which we gather information about available cover points. Minimum value is 1, as it multiplies with the tick-rate of the fixed AI tick rate of 0.1 (Default: 20)

vars.name: ai.npc_cover_path_vs_straight_dist_max_diff
vars.help: npc_cover_path_vs_straight_dist_max_diff defines what the maximum difference between straight-line distance and path distance can be when evaluating cover points. (default: 2)

vars.name: ai.npc_cover_use_path_distance
vars.help: If npc_cover_use_path_distance is set to true then npcs will look at the distance between the cover point and their target using the path between the two, rather than the straight-line distance.

vars.name: ai.npc_deliberate_hit_randomizer
vars.help: The percentage away from a maximum miss the randomizer is allowed to travel when shooting to deliberately hit the target (we don't want perfect hits with every shot). (default: 0.85f)

vars.name: ai.npc_deliberate_miss_offset_multiplier
vars.help: The offset with which the NPC will maximum miss the target. (default: 1.25)

vars.name: ai.npc_deliberate_miss_to_hit_alignment_time
vars.help: The time it takes for the NPC to deliberately miss to the time the NPC tries to hit its target. (default: 1.5)

vars.name: ai.npc_door_trigger_size
vars.help: npc_door_trigger_size defines the size of the trigger box on doors that opens the door as npcs walk close to it (default: 1.5)

vars.name: ai.npc_enable
vars.help: If npc_enable is set to false then npcs won't spawn. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_families_no_hurt
vars.help: If npc_families_no_hurt is true, npcs of the same family won't be able to hurt each other. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_gun_noise_silencer_modifier
vars.help: The modifier by which a silencer reduce the noise that a gun makes when shot. (Default: 0.15)

vars.name: ai.npc_htn_player_base_damage_modifier
vars.help: Baseline damage modifier for the new HTN Player NPCs to nerf their damage compared to the old NPCs. (default: 1.15f)

vars.name: ai.npc_htn_player_frustration_threshold
vars.help: npc_htn_player_frustration_threshold defines where the frustration threshold for NPCs go, where they have the opportunity to change to a more aggressive tactic. (default: 3)

vars.name: ai.npc_ignore_chairs
vars.help: If npc_ignore_chairs is true, npcs won't care about seeking out and sitting in chairs. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_junkpile_a_spawn_chance
vars.help: npc_junkpile_a_spawn_chance define the chance for scientists to spawn at junkpile a. (Default: 0.1)

vars.name: ai.npc_junkpile_dist_aggro_gate
vars.help: npc_junkpile_dist_aggro_gate define at what range (or closer) a junkpile scientist will get aggressive. (Default: 8)

vars.name: ai.npc_junkpile_g_spawn_chance
vars.help: npc_junkpile_g_spawn_chance define the chance for scientists to spawn at junkpile g. (Default: 0.1)

vars.name: ai.npc_junkpilespawn_chance
vars.help: defines the chance for scientists to spawn at NPC junkpiles. (Default: 0.1)

vars.name: ai.npc_max_junkpile_count
vars.help: npc_max_junkpile_count define how many npcs can spawn into the world at junkpiles at the same time (does not include monuments) (Default: 30)

vars.name: ai.npc_max_population_military_tunnels
vars.help: npc_max_population_military_tunnels defines the size of the npc population at military tunnels. (default: 3)

vars.name: ai.npc_max_roam_multiplier
vars.help: This is multiplied with the max roam range stat of an NPC to determine how far from its spawn point the NPC is allowed to roam. (default: 3)

vars.name: ai.npc_only_hurt_active_target_in_safezone
vars.help: If npc_only_hurt_active_target_in_safezone is true, npcs won't any player other than their actively targeted player when in a safe zone. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_patrol_point_cooldown
vars.help: npc_patrol_point_cooldown defines the cooldown time on a patrol point until it's available again (default: 5)

vars.name: ai.npc_reasoning_system_tick_rate_multiplier
vars.help: The rate at which we tick the reasoning system. Minimum value is 1, as it multiplies with the tick-rate of the fixed AI tick rate of 0.1 (Default: 1)

vars.name: ai.npc_respawn_delay_max_military_tunnels
vars.help: npc_respawn_delay_max_military_tunnels defines the maximum delay between spawn ticks at military tunnels. (default: 1920)

vars.name: ai.npc_respawn_delay_min_military_tunnels
vars.help: npc_respawn_delay_min_military_tunnels defines the minimum delay between spawn ticks at military tunnels. (default: 480)

vars.name: ai.npc_sensory_system_tick_rate_multiplier
vars.help: The rate at which we tick the sensory system. Minimum value is 1, as it multiplies with the tick-rate of the fixed AI tick rate of 0.1 (Default: 5)

vars.name: ai.npc_spawn_on_cargo_ship
vars.help: Spawn NPCs on the Cargo Ship. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_spawn_per_tick_max_military_tunnels
vars.help: npc_spawn_per_tick_max_military_tunnels defines how many can maximum spawn at once at military tunnels. (default: 1)

vars.name: ai.npc_spawn_per_tick_min_military_tunnels
vars.help: npc_spawn_per_tick_min_military_tunnels defineshow many will minimum spawn at once at military tunnels. (default: 1)

vars.name: ai.npc_speed_crouch_run
vars.help: npc_speed_crouch_run define the speed of an npc when in the crouched run state, and should be a number between 0 and 1. (Default: 0.25)

vars.name: ai.npc_speed_crouch_walk
vars.help: npc_speed_walk define the speed of an npc when in the crouched walk state, and should be a number between 0 and 1. (Default: 0.1)

vars.name: ai.npc_speed_run
vars.help: npc_speed_walk define the speed of an npc when in the run state, and should be a number between 0 and 1. (Default: 0.4)

vars.name: ai.npc_speed_sprint
vars.help: npc_speed_walk define the speed of an npc when in the sprint state, and should be a number between 0 and 1. (Default: 1.0)

vars.name: ai.npc_speed_walk
vars.help: npc_speed_walk define the speed of an npc when in the walk state, and should be a number between 0 and 1. (Default: 0.18)

vars.name: ai.npc_use_new_aim_system
vars.help: If npc_use_new_aim_system is true, npcs will miss on purpose on occasion, where the old system would randomize aim cone. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_use_thrown_weapons
vars.help: If npc_use_thrown_weapons is true, npcs will throw grenades, etc. This is an experimental feature. (default: true)

vars.name: ai.npc_valid_aim_cone
vars.help: npc_valid_aim_cone defines how close their aim needs to be on target in order to fire. (default: 0.8)

vars.name: ai.npc_valid_mounted_aim_cone
vars.help: npc_valid_mounted_aim_cone defines how close their aim needs to be on target in order to fire while mounted. (default: 0.92)

vars.name: ai.printignoredplayers
vars.help: Print a lost of all the players in the AI ignore list.

vars.name: ai.removeignoreplayer
vars.help: Remove a player (or command user if no player is specified) from the AIs ignore list.

vars.name: aimanager.ai_dormant
vars.help: If ai_dormant is true, any npc outside the range of players will render itself dormant and take up less resources, but wildlife won't simulate as well.

vars.name: aimanager.ai_dormant_max_wakeup_per_tick
vars.help: ai_dormant_max_wakeup_per_tick defines the maximum number of dormant agents we will wake up in a single tick. (default: 30)

vars.name: aimanager.ai_htn_animal_tick_budget
vars.help: ai_htn_animal_tick_budget defines the maximum amount of milliseconds ticking htn animal agents are allowed to consume. (default: 4 ms)

vars.name: aimanager.ai_htn_player_junkpile_tick_budget
vars.help: ai_htn_player_junkpile_tick_budget defines the maximum amount of milliseconds ticking htn player junkpile agents are allowed to consume. (default: 4 ms)

vars.name: aimanager.ai_htn_player_tick_budget
vars.help: ai_htn_player_tick_budget defines the maximum amount of milliseconds ticking htn player agents are allowed to consume. (default: 4 ms)

vars.name: aimanager.ai_htn_use_agency_tick
vars.help: If ai_htn_use_agency_tick is true, the ai manager's agency system will tick htn agents at the ms budgets defined in ai_htn_player_tick_budget and ai_htn_animal_tick_budget. If it's false, each agent registers with the invoke system individually, with no frame-budget restrictions. (default: true)

vars.name: aimanager.ai_to_player_distance_wakeup_range
vars.help: If an agent is beyond this distance to a player, it's flagged for becoming dormant.

vars.name: aimanager.nav_disable
vars.help: If set to true the navmesh won't generate.. which means Ai that uses the navmesh won't be able to move

vars.name: aimanager.nav_obstacles_carve_state
vars.help: nav_obstacles_carve_state defines which obstacles can carve the terrain. 0 - No carving, 1 - Only player construction carves, 2 - All obstacles carve.

vars.name: aimanager.nav_wait
vars.help: If true we'll wait for the navmesh to generate before completely starting the server. This might cause your server to hitch and lag as it generates in the background.

vars.name: aimanager.pathfindingiterationsperframe
vars.help: The maximum amount of nodes processed each frame in the asynchronous pathfinding process. Increasing this value will cause the paths to be processed faster, but can cause some hiccups in frame rate. Default value is 100, a good range for tuning is between 50 and 500.

vars.name: aimanager.setdestination_navmesh_failsafe
vars.help: If set to true, npcs will attempt to place themselves on the navmesh if not on a navmesh when set destination is called.
